summary: Join a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive! As a Junior Frontend Developer at BairesDev, you will contribute to building user interfaces for web applications and work closely with experienced developers to implement designs, enhance functionality, and grow your skills in frontend technologies.
responsibilities: Develop responsive user interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Implement UI components following design specifications.
Collaborate with backend developers to integrate frontend with API services.
Assist in troubleshooting and fixing UI issues and bugs.
Participate in code reviews to improve quality and expand knowledge.
Learn and apply modern frontend frameworks and libraries.

Solid knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript
Basic experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Angular, or Vue)
Knowledge of version control systems, preferably Git
benefits: Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred
Hardware and software setup for you to work from home
Flexible hours: create your own schedule
Paid parental leaves, vacations, and national holidays
Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent
